name: Shohaku
source:
[i]"Ah, you can pay me later. Instead, make sure the kid gets something energizing to eat."[/i]

A doctor residing in the Abyss. He is an exiled former noble, and is currently researching the Hari Disease, the epidemic disease of the the Abyss.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
